scope: Six authored writer-boundary turns, not six full runtime or browser sessions. Current validation accepts $100; historical blockers are injected. These thin constraints omit real numeric/date bounds. Results remain probe observations, not production equivalence.

checks.assessment_method: manual review of stored typed intent, visible output and route receipts; no extra paid judge
checks.assistant_prompt: MRNA only has price history starting from late July 2020, so an August 2026 window is beyond what's available. Would you like to pick a different date range?
findings: Reply asks for a new date range, matching the current category.
Reply incorrectly uses the first-history date in 2020 to explain why an August 2026 date cannot be tested.
